name: 2-butene-1,4-diol
description: 2-Butene-1,4-diol (CAS 110-64-5 ), also known commercially as Agrisynth B2D and 1,4-dihydroxy-2-butene, is a bifunctional allylic diol used as a building block and functional ingredient across personal care and food-related applications. Its dual hydroxyl groups make it a reactive intermediate for synthesis as well as a direct-use humectant and flavoring component. In personal care formulations, it functions as a humectant to support moisture retention in skin and hair care products. Food and flavor manufacturers use it as a flavoring agent and acidulant in finished formulations where controlled acidity and taste profile are required. As a synthetic intermediate, it serves in the production of specialty chemicals and polymers. It is also utilized in fragrance compounds where the reactive double bond is a key point of chemical modification. Cosmetic formulators sourcing for moisturizing systems may evaluate it alongside conventional glycols for compatibility. This chemical is available as a liquid at standard commercial purities suitable for industrial and specialty chemical use. Food-grade and technical-grade designations are the most commonly encountered specifications in the market. It is typically supplied in drums or intermediate bulk containers depending on order volume.
